calculation.description: Contrarian recovery signal: penalizes extended rebounds from the 60-day trough in proportion to the 20-day risk-adjusted return consistency. Higher values indicate less mature or less persistent recoveries and are expected to outperform over the next 10 trading days.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2026-2033 using the 15-asset tradable cross-asset universe and at least 8 valid instruments per date. IC uncertainty is material due to the small cross-section; 10-day IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates, with strongest decay at 20 days.
